Class Sim

java.lang.Object
simscli.sims.Sim
Direct Known Subclasses:
AdultSim, ChildSim, ElderSim
public abstract class Sim extends Object
Core Sim class: orchestrates components for stats, banking, employment, assets, and pets. Maintains the public API for backward compatibility while delegating to focused components. Follows Single Responsibility Principle by separating concerns into discrete components.
